item.title: [MSFT Bearish (-0.44)] INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses on their Investment in Microsoft Corporation of Class Action Lawsuit and Upcoming Deadlines - MSFT
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bearish (-0.44)
Pomerantz LLP has filed a class action lawsuit against Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT), advising investors with losses to contact them regarding upcoming deadlines. The lawsuit alleges securities fraud or unlawful business practices, stemming from disappointing Q2 fiscal 2026 results including slowed Azure growth, increased capital expenditures, and significantly lower-than-expected Copilot seat adoption, which caused Microsoft's stock price to fall. Further revelations from The Wall Street Journal about Copilot's functionality issues and subsequent reorganization also contributed to stock declines.

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.04)] Microsoft unveils open-source agent that generates unit tests
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Neutral (+0.04)
Microsoft has released "code-testing-generator," an open-source agent designed to generate unit tests across various programming languages. This agent learns from a user's repository, then plans, writes, and validates these tests, though its current scope is limited to unit tests only. It uses a "research-plan-implement" pipeline to identify code needing tests, determine the testing approach, and ensure the generated tests are effective and useful before completion.

item.title: [AAPL Bearish (-0.28)] Using This Apple Privacy Feature? Researchers Warn It Has a Flaw
item.description:
Sentiment: AAPL Bearish (-0.28)
Researchers have identified a flaw in Apple's Private Relay feature that may inadvertently expose users' IP addresses, even when the feature is enabled. The vulnerability stems from WebKit, Apple's browser engine, and particularly affects users who utilize passkeys, which bypass Private Relay. This issue allows for DNS leaks and the exposure of real IP addresses, contradicting the privacy assurances of Private Relay.

item.title: [AMZN Bullish (+0.20)] O’Reilly Automotive, suppliers sharing tariff refund benefits
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bullish (+0.20)
O’Reilly Automotive is sharing the benefits of refunds from now-invalidated tariffs with its suppliers, as its sourcing model primarily relies on suppliers as the importer of record. The auto parts retailer stated that direct tariff rebates are handled through cost of goods negotiations and aims to ensure both O'Reilly and its supplier partners benefit. This approach differs from other retailers like Amazon and Walmart, which plan to return funds to customers or cut prices, and Ford, which will use refunds for business divisions.

item.title: [MSFT Bearish (-0.24)] New York Times Fails to Add Microsoft Claim in OpenAI IP Suit
item.description:
Sentiment: MSFT Bearish (-0.24)

The judge ruled that the newspaper's attempt to add these theories of contributory infringement was too late, despite a recent US Supreme Court ruling on platform liability. The court noted that The Times could have asserted these claims earlier but chose not to.

item.title: [AMZN Bearish (-0.28)] Amazon sued by Universal Electronics for infringing smart-device patents
item.description:

item.title: [MSFT Neutral (+0.12)] We Energies says Microsoft won’t be held to contract terms that conflict with state regulators’ order
item.description:

item.title: [MSFT Bearish (-0.25)] Microsoft excludes Domain Exclusion from MS 365 Copilot – days after rolling it out
item.description:

This feature allowed administrators to block up to 1,000 web domains from influencing Copilot's answers. The company did not provide a reason for the rollback but indicated that they are evaluating next steps, leaving organizations without a previously welcomed control over AI-generated content.
